name: Javi López, Borja Giménez Larraz - Après le § 37 - Am 25
title: INTERIM REPORT in view of the consent procedure on the Political, Economic and Cooperation Strategic Partnership Agreement between the EU and Mexico
part_text: 37a. Regrets the inclusion of provisions prohibiting the imposition of customs duties on e-commerce transactions; notes this may undermine fiscal sovereignty and lead to a loss of public revenues for Mexico and the EU Member States; calls on the Commission to reassess these provisions and ensure that digital trade rules do not erode the tax base;
